The card has no publish and no discard control. A malformed part renders nothing and does not crash; a turn without the part renders exactly as today. Strings are in every locale pack, links carry accessible names, and no locale overflows. Seat ruling on the shape: `verdict.refusals` / `advisories` reuse `RuntimeAuthoringIssueSchema` arrays from `@objectstack/spec/api`, since that is what the door's `list_drafts` verdict returns (`runtime mcp-authoring.ts:405-414`). Nothing under `ui/` renders a `save_metadata_draft` / `list_drafts` result outside tests. The build chat front end retired by #37720 (with its `DraftReview` type) is not revived or reused. Full report: `/mnt/project-files/card-38048/pre-claim-report-0e90d2f9.md`.

Final part shape, for cloud#5172 to follow (also in the PR body):

```
{ type: 'data-draft-review', id: 'draft-review', data: {
    drafts: [{ type, name, package, label?,
               verdict: { publishable, refusals: RuntimeAuthoringIssue[], advisories: RuntimeAuthoringIssue[] } | null,
               verdictWithheld?: { code, message, status }, verdictError?: { code, message, status },
               verdictRead: 'turn-end' | 'save',
               review: { changes, item } }],   // 1..50 rows; links are Console paths; every object closed
    omitted?: number } }                         // integer >= 1, absent when none
```
Changes from the card's sketch: `verdict` must be present (null, not left out); `review` is closed at `changes` and `item` (do not forward the door's `note`); `drafts` holds at least one row; `omitted` is never 0.

## os-dev-report delta — `3a44ab65ad421afb684e06cf8fc4faf3253e76c8`

Answers L1 REVISE 7232462684 (R1–R3) and contract review 7232434714 (S1, S2, N1). Commits since `fb2070cda`: `98b52b0a6` (M1, `Metadata-protocol: added`) and `3a44ab65a` (below).

- **R1 / S1.** `consolePath` is `/^\/(?!\/)[^\\\s\u0000-\u001F\u007F]*$/`: one leading `/`, never `//`, and no backslash, whitespace or C0/DEL control character anywhere. Refusal rows in `draft-review.test.ts` (both `item` and `changes`): `/\evil.example/x`, `/<TAB>/evil.example/x` (a real tab), `/<LF>/evil.example/x`, a space, a NUL, plus the earlier `https:`, `//`, `javascript:`, relative and empty. Accept row: a link spelled as `studioItemReviewLink` / `studioChangesReviewLink` build it, segments through `encodeURIComponent` (a package with a space, a name with a backslash, a tab and a slash).
- **R2 / S2.** `drafts` description and the module text: one row per draft, unique by `package`, `type` and `name`; a draft saved more than once in the turn is one row, placed at its first save, carrying the verdict read last; `omitted` counts drafts, not saves. Reference page regenerated; `llms.txt` carries no description text.
- **R3 / N1.** The changeset, the PR body and the test header now say the five new objects are closed and the findings keep `RuntimeAuthoringIssueSchema`'s shape (an unknown key there is dropped). A new test pins the drop.
- **Overflow, eleven locales.** Measured in Chromium at 320 px and 280 px, 22 renders: nothing spills past the card, nothing scrolls, every verdict badge is one line. Control at 90 px: red (21 spilling elements). Readings and screenshots: `/mnt/project-files/card-38048/overflow/`.

- `check-changeset-no-major --event <replacement body>` → exit 0.
